core_obligations: Reduce to the affine local case and set up the induction on n = dim_x of the support of the fibre of F at s: the problem is local around x and s so one may take X and S affine and S local, and one may repeatedly replace S by an elementary etale neighbourhood (proof lines 2498-2509).

Use the elementary devissage to reduce to the case where X -> S is smooth with geometrically irreducible fibres of dimension n: choose the neighbourhoods, the diagram, the point z and the module G, base change everything to the localisation of S' at s', note the map g stays etale, and use the devissage lemmas to transfer the conclusion from (Y' -> S', pi_*G, y') to (X -> S, F, x) (proof lines 2511-2557).

Settle n = 0: a smooth morphism with geometrically irreducible fibres of dimension zero is an open immersion, the closed point of the local base lies in its image, so X = S, F corresponds to a finite flat module over the local ring and hence is finite free (proof lines 2559-2570).

Induction step: write S = Spec(A) with A local, X = Spec(B), F the sheaf of a B-module N, choose alpha : B^{direct sum r} -> N with isomorphic reduction modulo the minimal prime over m and with injective alpha and flat cokernel Q; note that the support of Q/mQ misses p so its dimension at q is below n, apply the induction hypothesis to Q over an elementary etale neighbourhood, then conclude that the middle term N_g of the resulting short exact sequence is flat and finitely presented (proof lines 2572-2614).
proof_roadmap: Make the situation affine and local and induct on the dimension of the support in the closed fibre (proof lines 2498-2509).
Use the elementary devissage to reduce to the smooth case over a local base (proof lines 2511-2557).
Base case: dimension zero forces X = S and a finite flat module is free (proof lines 2559-2570).
Induction step: split off a finite free piece with flat cokernel of smaller fibre dimension and descend flatness and finite presentation to the middle term (proof lines 2572-2614).
difficulty_reason: The proposition is the local structure theorem for a finite type quasi-coherent sheaf that is flat at a point: after an elementary etale neighbourhood of the image point there is an open subscheme of the base change containing the relevant point over which the pullback is finitely presented and flat over the localised base (statement lines 2476-2496, tag 05I5). The counted first proof is a long genuine induction: it reduces to the affine local case, uses the elementary devissage to reach a smooth morphism with geometrically irreducible fibres of dimension n, disposes of n = 0 through the open immersion criterion, and then finds a finite free submodule with flat cokernel whose fibre support has strictly smaller dimension, applying the induction hypothesis and inferring flatness and finite presentation from the resulting short exact sequence. The induction step is the substance, so the claim is H2.
